response.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0056"
      ],
      "quote": "The procedure runs on the Halverton e-Tendering Portal, and every message about it goes through the portal's messaging service.",
      "statement": "Every message about the procedure goes through the portal's messaging service.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0057"
      ],
      "quote": "The Council does not accept tenders or questions by e-mail, by post or by telephone.",
      "statement": "The Council does not accept tenders or questions by e-mail, by post, or by telephone; this states a rule for the buyer.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0058"
      ],
      "quote": "To take part, a supplier registers on the portal and expresses an interest in this procedure, which gives it access to every tender document and to the messaging service.",
      "statement": "To take part, a supplier registers on the portal and expresses an interest in this procedure.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0060"
      ],
      "quote": "The Council handles the personal data in tenders under its privacy notice for procurement, which is published on the portal.",
      "statement": "The Council handles personal data under its privacy notice; this binds the buyer, not the supplier.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0061"
      ],
      "quote": "Information in a tender is confidential to the Council and its advisers, except where the law obliges the Council to publish it.",
      "statement": "Information in a tender is confidential to the Council and its advisers, which binds the buyer.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0062"
      ],
      "quote": "The portal offers a test upload, through which bidders can check that their files open before they submit them.",
      "statement": "Bidders can check that their files open using a test upload on the portal.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0063"
      ],
      "quote": "The procurement team answers questions about the portal from 09:00 to 17:00 on Working Days.",
      "statement": "The procurement team answers questions from 09:00 to 17:00 on Working Days, binding the buyer's team.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0064"
      ],
      "quote": "Bidders who have trouble with the portal close to the deadline can call the procurement team, which logs each call with its time.",
      "statement": "Bidders who have trouble with the portal close to the deadline can call the procurement team.",
      "modality": "will",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0065"
      ],
      "quote": "Tenders must be submitted through the Halverton e-Tendering Portal by 12:00 GMT on 2027-01-15, and the portal accepts no upload after that time.",
      "statement": "Benders submit tenders through the Halverton e-Tendering Portal by 12:00 GMT on 2027-01-15.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0066"
      ],
      "quote": "Bidders may ask clarification questions through the portal until 12:00 GMT on 2026-12-18.",
      "statement": "Bidders may ask clarification questions through the portal until 12:00 GMT on 2026-12-18.",
      "modality": "may",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0067"
      ],
      "quote": "The Council publishes each answer to all bidders through the portal, without naming the bidder who asked.",
      "statement": "The Council publishes each answer through the portal, binding the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0068"
      ],
      "quote": "A tender consists of three files: the quality response, the completed price schedule in Annex C, and the Form of Tender in Annex D.",
      "statement": "A tender consists of three files: the quality response, the completed price schedule in Annex C, and the Form of Tender in Annex D.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0069"
      ],
      "quote": "The Form of Tender must be signed by a director of the bidder and uploaded as a separate file, and a tender without it is rejected.",
      "statement": "The Form of Tender must be signed by a director of the bidder and uploaded as a separate file.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0070"
      ],
      "quote": "The portal shows a receipt for each file once its upload is complete.",
      "statement": "The portal shows a receipt for each file once upload is complete, describing system behavior.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0071"
      ],
      "quote": "The quality response is one PDF file of at most 30 pages of A4, set in type of at least 11 points, and pages after the thirtieth are not read.",
      "statement": "The quality response is one PDF file of at most 30 pages of A4, set in type of at least 11 points.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0072"
      ],
      "quote": "The quality response must not name the bidder, its staff, its subcontractors or its clients, so that evaluators can score it without knowing who wrote it.",
      "statement": "The quality response must not name the bidder, its staff, its subcontractors, or its clients.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0073"
      ],
      "quote": "A response that names any of them scores zero on the question concerned.",
      "statement": "A response that names any of them scores zero on the question concerned.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0074"
      ],
      "quote": "If the tender documents conflict, they apply in this order: any addendum, the latest first; this document; Annex B; the other annexes.",
      "statement": "If the tender documents conflict, they apply in the specified order.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": [
        "SRC-0075"
      ],
      "quote": "The Council publishes any addendum on the portal at least ten days before the tender deadline.",
      "statement": "The Council publishes any addendum on the portal at least ten days before the tender deadline, binding the buyer.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
